description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per document pair — the payment buys one signed breaking-change diff report for one pair of submitted documents: counts per published token and located findings for every element the rules of breaking-change-diff/v1 record as removed, added, or changed between the two versions you submitted, each item stated as it appears in the documents. Submitted documents are processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends both documents. The report establishes only the differences between the two documents you submitted, under the published rules; it is not a 'safe to upgrade' certification.

pairs.description: Alternative multi-pair form: an array of {version_a, version_b} pairs; each pair is charged at $0.02 on the paid endpoint. Mutually exclusive in effect with the single-pair version_a/version_b fields.

version_a.description: Version A of the API-surface document: an OpenAPI 3.0.x/3.1.x document in JSON form, or a standalone JSON Schema document (draft-07, 2019-09, or 2020-12). Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

version_b.description: Version B of the same API-surface document, in the same form as version A. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

name: apidiff_diff
